vector_memory.semantic_summary: MtlParser is a specialized service responsible for ingesting raw text content from Wavefront .mtl files. It parses material definitions line-by-line, utilizing a state machine to track and populate material properties like color, shininess, and texture maps. The component converts raw string data into a structured ParsedMtlData object, which is then returned for downstream rendering pipeline consumption.
